answer: The strongest single control I know for this is error correction pattern fingerprint, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 18 minutes once; the operator of 504 fakes spends 9072 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. A inlet of doubt is healthy, a dune of proof is required, and a pearl of patience is the price of a clean panel. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
